plain_italian_verdict: Possiamo procedere con un soft go-live solo sandbox: le macchine possono scoprire, leggere e testare il servizio in modo controllato. Restano bloccati pagamenti reali, fatture, marketplace pubblico, hosted MCP pubblico, outreach umano e dati clienti reali.

agent_votes.reason: The system has enough evidence to run a controlled sandbox-only soft go-live, while keeping irreversible and paid actions blocked.
The machine-first positioning is coherent: sell decisions, scores, discovery packs and action payloads to automated systems.
Public assets are reachable and machine-readable; no website correction is required before the next sandbox-only control pack.
OpenAPI and MCP manifests are aligned and expose the core machine actions.
No-list Target Discovery is understandable by machines through market, area and commercial_objective.
The valid-output rule, duplicate handling and no-real-data perimeter are explicit enough for sandbox use.
Score, confidence, commercial strength and next-product routing are visible and usable by automated workflows.
Products, prices, validity rules and machine outputs are clear in the product catalog.
Passive machine-readable distribution can proceed; irreversible marketplace or registry publication remains blocked.
The next test should capture machine comprehension, endpoint errors and missing-field feedback without involving human outreach.
The commercial path can be tested as machine discovery plus sandbox evaluation, not human selling.
Order retrieval, usage visibility and Action Pack delivery are tested enough for sandbox-only support simulation.
Fiscal, payment, invoice, reconciliation and P.IVA gates are not ready for paid go-live.
Real customer data, personal data, public paid terms, DPA, privacy and retention policies must be completed before monetization.
The next learning loop should compare machine comprehension and failure cases against competing API/provider patterns.
Agent coverage is sufficient for the next controlled stage; recurring self-improvement should remain evidence-based and supervised.

consolidated_findings: The machine-first public path is now readable: a machine can understand what MachineSignal sells and which endpoint to call.
The commercial model is clear enough for sandbox testing: existing list -> Score Pack, no list -> Target Discovery, high signal -> Deep Analysis, confirmed action gate -> Action Pack.
The technical contract is aligned across OpenAPI, MCP root manifest and .well-known manifest.
The system remains safely bounded: no payment, no invoice, no outreach, no external publication, no production keys and no real data.
The main remaining risk is not product clarity but business activation: fiscal/legal/payment readiness and real external demand are not yet validated.
A soft go-live must be framed as sandbox-only machine evaluation, not as a paid public launch.

recommended_next_action.purpose: Define exactly what a machine can do in the soft go-live, what remains blocked, what evidence we collect and what owner approval is required before any paid/public escalation.
